description: Department of Wildlife Conservation - Notify the Kodigahakanda Sanctuary, in Olaboduwa, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a sanctuary under the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance, which constitutes a regulatory/legal action. It exercises powers granted by existing legislation to create a protected area, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, land, or other specialized category.
